title: Becoming an individual; music and sports as keys
summary: Jones says a star must become an individual, and that music and sports are the two keys to human life, with athletes who try to play instruments.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: You just send for Milt Hinton. As a keynote, people do not know what it means to become a star. It is to become an individual, like a Fats Waller, like a Louis Armstrong, like a Dizzy Gillespie, like a Charlie Parker, like an Art Tatum, or like an Erroll Garner. It takes a long time to become an individual. The only way we get this, Milt, you know how it is - it's the way we live. You know it's very difficult. We would love to play with each other all the time, but circumstances do not warrant the fact that we can play with each other like in baseball or football. You would love to have the great football

player over here. Incidentally, Milt, I will tell you this now. I said it when they opened up a place when I was with the baseball players. I said, "Why don't you get a baseball player that can be to bat for the pitcher?" Now I'm the only person in the world that has ever said that they should have a baseball pitcher to bat instead of the pitcher batting -

Pinch hitter. Now they got to go controversial now. But what happens, music and sports and education is the only things that we've had the keyword in the whole world for 2,000, 3,000, 5-, 6,000 years. But we are fortunate that the musicians and sports is the two keywords to put the sweetening in the cake. You will notice that all athletes, he'll always try to play guitar, he'll try to play trumpet, he'll try to do everything. How do you think you're going to get a man like Stan Musial? The man liked guitar, but he's an athlete.

I took him to Manny's to get him his guitar. I personally took him to Manny's, with Manny's son. But that is what we're talking about - we're dealing with human life now. Music and sports are the two major keys out here. It has always been when the peoples had wars years ago, 10,000 years ago, they got the musicians, they got the
